summary: The visible suite now passes (2 passed). I changed one file, `solution/core.py`. The cause was a typo in the escaped-quote check inside `parse_csv_line`: it tested whether the character after a `"` was `"'"` (a single quote) instead of `'"'` (a double quote). As a result, a doubled quote inside a quoted field was treated as the end of the field, so `""` escapes failed with "character after closing quote." I changed that one comparison and left the public API, `tests/`, and the rest of the parser untouched. I also spot-checked a few extra inputs (trailing commas, quoted commas, `"x"""`, plain fields) and they parse as expected.
